claudeCode.command: claude mcp add --transport stdio rust-security-auditor -- npx --yes rust-security-auditor

vsCodeCopilot.file: .vscode/mcp.json or the user mcp.json opened by VS Code

claudeDesktop.note: The package does not ship the .mcpb Desktop Extension expected by the current official Claude Desktop installation flow.

tools.name: rust_audit_project
tools.whenToUse: Before release or for a full-project Rust security health check.

tools.name: rust_audit_dependencies
tools.whenToUse: For Cargo dependency and supply-chain review.

tools.name: rust_review_current_diff
tools.whenToUse: Before commit, before PR, after agent-generated code, or after touching unsafe/dependencies/build.rs. Returns reviewDecision, suppressionSummary, and suggestedFixPrompt values without modifying code or adding suppressions.

tools.name: rust_list_accepted_risks
tools.whenToUse: Before release, during security re-review, when checking expired suppressions, or when cleaning up invalid suppression comments. Returns an accepted-risk inventory without running the full scanner or modifying code.

troubleshooting.symptom: MCP client fails while starting or parsing the first message.
troubleshooting.check: Configure npx --yes rust-security-auditor, or, when running a checkout, build it with npm run build and point node at the absolute dist/src/mcp/server.js path. npm --silent run mcp is only a checkout debugging command because it rebuilds before launch.
Pass an absolute local path or set the client cwd so a relative projectPath resolves to an existing directory.
Use a Cargo project or workspace directory containing at least one Cargo.toml.
Ensure projectPath is inside a Git work tree and that there are unstaged working-tree changes, staged changes with staged=true, or explicit base/head changes.

troubleshooting.symptom: The server starts from a client but tools are not visible.
troubleshooting.check: Run npm run typecheck and npm test locally, then restart the MCP client so it reloads the tool list.

troubleshooting.symptom: Accepted risk inventory omits expired or invalid suppressions.
troubleshooting.check: Call rust_list_accepted_risks with includeExpired=true and includeInvalid=true.
